welcome.title: Welcome to Hostel Expense Tracker
welcome.body: This app keeps your hostel money clear: fees collected from residents, money spent on shared bills, and what is left.

bullets.0: Track monthly service fees per resident
bullets.1: Record shared expenses (electricity, repairs, and more)
bullets.2: See current balance: collected minus paid expenses

residents.title: 1. Add your residents
residents.body: Start on Residents. Each person has their own monthly fee — it does not have to be the same for everyone.

bullets.0: Add name, room, phone, and monthly fee (EGP)
bullets.1: Only active residents show up in monthly payment tracking
bullets.2: Deactivate someone who left without deleting history later if you need

payments.title: 2. Mark monthly payments
payments.body: Each month is tracked separately. The current month is created for you; you can open other months too.

bullets.0: Mark each active resident paid or unpaid
bullets.1: Payment amount defaults to their monthly fee — you can edit it
bullets.2: Paid amounts increase total collected and the balance

expenses.title: 3. Log hostel expenses
expenses.body: Record bills and spending with a category, amount, date, and who added them.

bullets.0: Only expenses marked paid reduce the balance left
bullets.1: Unpaid bills stay visible so you do not forget them
bullets.2: Toggle paid / unpaid anytime from the list

dashboard.title: 4. Read the dashboard
dashboard.body: Home shows this month’s collection progress, unpaid residents, recent spending, and overall balance.

bullets.0: Current balance = all paid fees − all paid expenses
bullets.1: Month chips show paid vs not paid among active residents only
bullets.2: Use Track payments or Add expense for quick actions

ready.title: You’re ready
ready.body: Typical flow: add residents → collect this month’s fees → log expenses → check balance on the dashboard.

bullets.0: Switch language with ع / EN in the header (Arabic is RTL)
bullets.1: Cycle light, dark, or system theme with the sun/moon icon
bullets.2: Reopen this tour anytime with the ? button in the header
